purpose: Preparation queue for original reproducible SHAR Production research. No item may be labelled published, benchmarked, cited or statistically conclusive until its dataset, methodology, source code and verification evidence exist.

assets.title: AI Video Production Benchmark 2026
assets.claim_boundary: No performance ranking or market statistic until a disclosed reproducible test corpus, model/version matrix, scoring rubric and raw results exist.
assets.planned_method: Versioned task corpus, pre-registered scoring rubric and run logs. Synthetic fixtures must be explicitly labelled.
distribution_candidates: Zenodo if owner account authorizes and deposition is eligible

assets.title: AI vs CGI vs Hybrid Production Cost/Time Benchmark
assets.claim_boundary: No cost or time claims without disclosed estimation model or non-confidential aggregate first-party data with sampling rules.
assets.planned_method: Scenario definitions and transparent unit-cost/time assumptions; separate observed measures from estimates.

assets.title: AI Video Consistency Failure Taxonomy
assets.claim_boundary: No frequency rates or model comparisons until labelled example corpus and independent reproducibility checks exist.
assets.planned_method: Taxonomy of observable failure classes with synthetic or licensed examples, annotation protocol and adjudication record.

assets.title: Commercial AI Video Rights & Readiness Benchmark
assets.claim_boundary: Not legal advice and no rights-clearance claims; the output assesses disclosed metadata completeness against a published rubric.
assets.planned_method: Run rights-labelled synthetic manifests through documented structural and policy checks; label all fixtures synthetic.

assets.title: AI/CGI Production Workflow Reliability Benchmark
assets.claim_boundary: No production reliability or commercial performance claims without disclosed workflow fixtures, pass/fail criteria and rerunnable test logs.
assets.planned_method: Define staged delivery-manifest scenarios and measure deterministic validation/release-gate outcomes; distinguish tooling validation from finished-film quality.
